title: Breakfast for Eight (Café da manhã para oito)

scenes.title: A fita vermelha
scenes.summary: On Tuesday morning Evelyn happily recovers her own suitcase while the unclaimed bag stays locked away.

scenes.title: Sem leite na geladeira
scenes.summary: Twenty minutes before breakfast, Tessa's supplier van breaks down and the kitchen is out of milk and eggs.

scenes.title: Contando o troco
scenes.summary: Hannah returns breathless with two full grocery bags and counts the exact change for Arthur.

scenes.title: Ervas do pátio
scenes.summary: Graham clips fresh green herbs from his courtyard pot to finish the scrambled eggs right on time.

scenes.title: Suco na gravata
scenes.summary: Evelyn enjoys her tea without sugar while Arthur tries to impress the room and spills orange juice on his silk tie.

scenes.title: A ligação de sexta-feira
scenes.summary: A nervous male caller phones the front desk to check on the blue suitcase and hangs up without giving his name.

scenes.title: Como os clientes habituais pedem
scenes.summary: During the quiet afternoon lull, Tessa shares coffee with Hannah while Graham fixes a wobbly chair.

scenes.title: Dois nomes, um quarto
scenes.summary: Checking the evening ledger, Arthur turns pale: he booked two separate guests into Room 7 on a sold-out night.
